field_check.notes: All six cards contain target, ID/category rationale, type/Story/scope, exact file list/write set, hard/soft requires, acceptance commands, negative oracle, close conditions, evidence landing, owner, non-claim boundary and stop condition.

findings.title: S4.24b Windows exit-code-2 negative oracle is not executable inside the declared write set
findings.location: tasks.md:3184 (negative e), :3168 (only new test file, POSIX-only build tag), :3189 (stop condition), :3185 (close conditions 4/5)
findings.evidence: (e) requires Windows/non-POSIX exit code 2 before any side effect, but the only declared new test file is tagged integration && (aix||darwin||dragonfly||freebsd||linux||netbsd||openbsd||solaris) and is not compiled on Windows. main_test.go:650 covers maintenance extra argv exit 2; TestRecoveryRootStartup (main_test.go:11032) covers only recovery invalid-argument exit 2 and verify exit 1; recovery_exclusive_test.go has no build tag but uses an injected fake facility and asserts ErrAdmissionUnsupported, not process exit code. The card write set contains no Windows-compilable test file and the stop condition forbids unlisted files.
findings.impact: Close conditions (4)(5) lack a falsifiable oracle; ADR-0032 release condition 3 (framework.md:1114, Windows exits 2 before side effects) has no B13J carrier.
findings.suggestion: Either add a non-POSIX test file to the write set (slots 6 to 7, unique files 14 to 15, update Plan :1311/:1641 and ownership index), or remove (e) from this card and route it to ADR-0032 release condition 3 with a named carrier card.
findings.close_condition: Card text, write set and slot counts agree, and (e) points to a test that compiles on its target platform and can fail when exit code is not 2.

findings.title: S4.22 mixes ADR revision number with design revision number
findings.evidence: Card says ADR-0032 r60 and an 11-port assembly. framework.md:1068 records ADR-0032 revision adr-0032-r03; no ADR-0032 r60 exists. r60 is the design revision identity-auth-design-ir01-r60 (design.md:5 and :3601, 11-port production root list).
findings.impact: Traceability: searching ADR-0032 r60 fails, and authority for the 11-port list is misattributed from design r60 to the ADR.
findings.suggestion: Reword to design identity-auth-design-ir01-r60 section r60 11-port list, with boundaries governed by ADR-0032 r03; keep the close-condition reference to the design list.
findings.close_condition: No nonexistent ADR revision appears; each reference resolves to a real artifact and section.

findings.title: Declared-slot accounting differs between D cards and implementation cards
findings.evidence: 22 path slots dedupe to exactly 14 files (2+2+4+4+6+4), so the numbers are self-consistent. But D05/D06 count their evidence reports inside 2 files, while the four implementation cards explicitly exclude evidence reports from their 4/4/6/4 slots.
findings.impact: Cross-batch comparison and the declared-slot-equals-written-files gate can diverge; implementation safety is unaffected.
findings.suggestion: Adopt one rule (evidence never counted in code write set, but declared separately in evidence landing; or always counted) and state it in Plan :1311.
findings.close_condition: One accounting rule is stated in the Plan and applied uniformly to all six cards.

findings.title: Registration round lacks author evidence package and Plan before-image is not reproducible
findings.evidence: No author (Carson) report.md or index.json exists in the directory. Claimed tasks-before.md and plan-before.md snapshots do not exist anywhere in the repository. The tasks.md baseline is independently reproducible (first 3034 lines plus restored statistics lines gives 823187 B and F1D65B0D7016CDBF9C2F4E85B012B5B0B9F714B6DF0C7CDC9326C05676900E34), but the Plan 497542 B baseline cannot be recomputed; only 1628 to 1651 (+23 lines, 25 added / 2 replaced) is self-consistent.
findings.impact: The byte-level change record is not independently verifiable from the author side; static verifiability of the six cards and Plan text is unaffected.
findings.suggestion: Add an author index.json with before/after hashes, bytes, line counts and hunk ranges; provide a reproducible Plan before-image or a git blob identifier instead of a physical snapshot.
findings.close_condition: Author evidence gives reproducible before/after hashes and hunk ranges for both files.

findings.title: ADR-0032 :1121 parenthetical (not yet registered as a formal Task) became historical after this registration
findings.evidence: :1121 reads candidate S4.23 (anchor adapter bundle four ports complete and registered; not yet registered as a formal Task) complete. After this round S4.23 is a formal Task. :1124/:1125 use candidate S4.24a/S4.22 as category labels, which do not conflict with the registration state.
findings.impact: Traceability of the release-order text only; the substantive gate (bundle delivered and Exclusive leaves recoveryClosedPort) is unchanged and neither registration nor implementation is blocked.
findings.suggestion: Fold into the next ADR-0032 revision (together with the :1108 qualifier requested by B13J-PLAN-R04-F002): remove the parenthetical or make it time-neutral (planning ID; registration state in Tasks).
findings.close_condition: Next ADR-0032 revision contains no registration-state parenthetical conflicting with Tasks.
